assessment: This fundamental study provides insights into the mechanism controlling cell cycle reentry, establishing a regulatory role for Mecp2 degradation in shifting transcription from metabolic to proliferation genes during quiescence exit. The evidence, which includes experimental data from in vitro cell culture and an in vivo injury-induced liver regeneration model, is convincing but the trigger for MeCP2 degradation and how MeCP2 differentially regulates proliferation and metabolic genes remains unclear.
